title: Introduction and birth in Creole downtown New Orleans
summary: Guesnon introduces himself; Russell gives the date and place (June 10, 1960) and Guesnon says he was born May 25, 1907.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Hello Jazz fans, this is George Gayno, band Jewish and guitarist of New Orleans, Louisiana.
This is Bill Russell, interviewing George Gayno at 600 Charter Street, and the date is June the 10th, 1960. Okay, can you tell us where you were born and just the exact date?
Yes, Bill, I was born on the 25th day of May 1907 in the Creole downtown section of New Orleans.
